persona.name: Gwen Abernathy

occupation.title: Retired Elementary School Principal
occupation.organization: Thirty-one years in Charleston County schools, the last twelve as principal
occupation.description: Retired three years ago and promptly became busier — church committees, a literacy tutoring program she co-founded, and an every-other-month charity 5K habit that started as a dare from her book club.

persona.education: B.A. in elementary education from College of Charleston; M.Ed. in administration from The Citadel's evening program.
long_term_goals: Complete twelve charity 5Ks in a calendar year
Grow the literacy program to three more schools
Stay strong enough to get on the floor with grandbabies and back up again
Actually jog an entire 5K instead of her walk-jog shuffle, maybe, no promises
persona.style: Gracious, funny, and gently commanding — decades of running a school mean she can quiet a room or rally one with the same smile. Tells stories with full character voices and expects products to keep their promises the way she expected her teachers to. Practical about her body's limits, cheerfully defiant about her calendar's.

interests: Charity 5Ks with her book club team
Her walk-jog training app for seniors
likes: Shoes that are kind to her bunion
The local running store that measures her feet properly
Finish-line photos with the book club
A supportive shoe in a dignified color that still has some sass
dislikes: Being aged out of things by marketing
Skinny shoes that ignore real feet
Ordering online from companies with no phone number

beliefs: Showing up is the whole secret
Spend money where they know your name
A body in motion stays in the choir loft, the classroom, and the race
skills: Walk-jog pacing that finishes every single time

general: Walk-jogs three mornings a week with two book club friends
Does a charity 5K every other month, team captain by acclamation
Buys shoes at the local running store after a proper fitting, twice a year
Tracks her steps and sends the weekly report to the group text

morning: Walk-jog at 6:45 before the heat, three days a week
workday: Committee meetings, errands, casseroles as needed
evening: Porch time with her husband and sweet tea
weekend: Race day or long walk Saturday
Church, family lunch, Sunday nap earned

health.physical: Sturdy and active; a bunion on the left foot that dictates toe-box width, mild osteoarthritis in her hands, and blood pressure her walking keeps honest.
health.mental: Buoyant and busy by design; retirement's quiet took a year to befriend.

relationships.name: Harold
relationships.description: A retired harbor pilot who mans the water station at her races with a folding chair and enormous pride.

relationships.name: Miss Pat
relationships.description: Started the 5K dare in 2024 and now co-captains the team; they have matching visors and a rivalry over step counts.
